name: Select an installed Windows power plan
description: Review and, only after explicit confirmation, select one of the power plans already installed on the machine.
evidenceSummary: Power-plan behavior is hardware, firmware, workload, and battery-policy dependent. No universal performance benefit is assumed.
benchmarkRelevance: Compare a repeatable workload before and after, with variance reported
verificationProcedure: Read the active plan and compare its GUID with the requested target
rollbackProcedure: Restore the captured original active-plan GUID
prerequisites: The target plan exists on the machine
